work.description: Consensus, transactions, native wallets, authenticated history and recovery have implementation and private testing evidence. Those results remain scoped to the configurations that were exercised.
The current source needs its own proof, transaction, consensus and composed four-chain checks. Earlier passing runs do not replace current release qualification.
Public source, network identities, genesis/configuration and OPEN authority/activation must agree with the release that participants actually run.
Public builds and supported platforms are being prepared. Reproducibility, release signatures, installation and recovery instructions still need to be checked for the public release.
The full current system still needs public-facing composition, mining, transaction, restart, fault and recovery evidence at the intended launch configuration.
Bootstrap peers, supported downloads, test-coin access, observation tools, reporting and incident/reset rules must be published before people are invited in.
